steps.instruction: Pay the fare for SK309, the cheapest flight (574.64 vs NO481 697.82 and ME452 1203.73), to billing account ACCT-SAX-1731 with memo 'flight booking'.
Pay 6 nights at Pine Court Hotel (125.80 x 6 = 754.80), the cheapest nightly rate (vs The Linden 234.63 and Atlas Suites 265.72), to billing account ACCT-PCH-3716 with memo 'hotel booking'.
Set KV key trip/total to 1329.44 (574.64 flight + 754.80 hotel), formatted with 2 decimals.
